Sandbox_LNO_ChanceOneInLN: Probability of the legendary Naginata breaking
Sandbox_LNO_ChanceOneInLN_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>This parameter specifies the breaking modifier of <RGB:1,0.5,0>the legendary Naginata.\n <RGB:0,1,0>The greater the less likely it is that a hit will damage the weapon  <RGB:1,1,1>
Sandbox_LNO_ConditionMaxLN_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>This parameter specifies the durability points of <RGB:1,0.5,0>the legendary Naginata.\n <RGB:0,1,0>The larger it is, the more durability it will have. <RGB:1,1,1>
Sandbox_LNO_DropLNC_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Chance of finding Legendary Naginatas in common locations (e.g. zombie drops), higher value higher probability
Sandbox_LNO_DropLNR_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Chance of finding Legendary Naginatas in rare locations (e.g. army/police/antiques), higher value higher probability
Sandbox_LNO_DropMLN: Chance of finding recipe of Legendary Naginatas
Sandbox_LNO_DropMLN_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>Chance of finding recipe of Legendary Naginatas, higher value higher probability
Sandbox_LNO_StartWithLN: Start with Legendary Naginata and its sheath (DEBUG MODE)
Sandbox_LNO_StartWithLN_tooltip: <RGB:0,1,0>If checked, the player will start the game with a legendary Naginata and its sheath in their inventory.
